query: 平等机会措施 平等机会措施 衡量企业在招聘、晋升及培训选拔过程中，为确保所有员工/候选人获得平等机会而设立的流程标准及量化监控机制。 一、内容质量得分 • 2分（卓越）：具备标准化的公平评估流程（如：结构化面试、匿名简历筛选、多元化评审委员会）；设定了具体的公平性监控指标（如：女性在关键岗位晋升中的提名率）；且定期审计流程中的潜在偏差。 • 1分（合格）：有明确的公平准则说明，具备基础的公开招聘/竞聘流程及员工培训选拔标准，但缺乏深层的偏差纠正工具或量化的公平监控指标。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关公平措施披露，或仅有笼统的“机会均等”声明。 平等机会 公平招聘 结构化面试 匿名简历 多元评审委员会 晋升提名率 薪酬平等 流程偏差审计 公开竞聘 equal opportunity fair recruitment structured interview blind CV screening diverse interview panel promotion nomination rate pay equity process bias audit open competition 招聘、晋升或培训选拔是否有明确公平准则、公开招聘/竞聘流程或统一选拔标准？ 是否采用结构化面试、匿名简历筛选或多元评审委员会？ 是否设定女性关键岗位提名率、晋升率或薪酬平等等监控指标？ 是否定期审计并纠正选拔流程中的潜在偏差？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '平等机会措施'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 招聘、晋升或培训选拔是否有明确公平准则、公开招聘/竞聘流程或统一选拔标准？ 是否采用结构化面试、匿名简历筛选或多元评审委员会？ 是否设定女性关键岗位提名率、晋升率或薪酬平等等监控指标？ 是否定期审计并纠正选拔流程中的潜在偏差？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有反歧视原则声明而无流程工具；仅有灵活办公；仅有员工满意度调查；仅有多元化人数占比而无选拔公平机制；区分：平等机会措施强调选拔流程与量化公平监控；反歧视政策强调禁止歧视规则；培训百分比是结果统计，不能单独证明存在公平选拔机制。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: The Group adheres to a people-oriented approach and builds a diversified development platform and an equal and inclusive working environment for its employees. The Group strictly complies with the relevant laws and regulations in the regions where it operates, such as the Labour Law of the PRC and the Labour Contract Law of the PRC in mainland China. The Group has continuously improved its employment management system and has formulated internal systems such as the Recruitment Management System, the Employee Manual and the Guidelines on Induction Training for New Employees to regulate the management of employment (including regular employees, labour dispatch, interns and retired staff) and to clarify the processes for the management of working hours, recruitment and dismissal of employees to safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of employees and the Group.

[Content]
The Group adheres to a people-oriented approach and builds a diversified development platform and an equal and inclusive working environment for its employees. The Group has continuously improved its employment management system and has formulated internal systems such as the Recruitment Management System, the Employee Manual and the Guidelines on Induction Training for New Employees to regulate the management of employment (including regular employees, labour dispatch, interns and retired staff) and to clarify the processes for the management of working hours, recruitment and dismissal of employees to safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of employees and the Group.

results.text: People-oriented, permanent protection of employee value. We attach great importance to the health and safety of our employees and have firmly established the safety concept of 'life first'. We continue to enhance our safety management capabilities and standards through whole-process and multi-faceted control measures such as education and training, safety management, review and evaluation. At the same time, the Group implements the concept of 'empathy' in dealing with people, respects human rights and advocates for the human rights principles and standards of international initiatives, including the principles of the United Nations Global Compact, the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, understands the needs and expectations of every employee, pays attention to the rights and welfare of employees, focuses on employee communication and care, and creates a fair, diverse and inclusive working environment. The results of the annual employee satisfaction survey maintain above the industry average.

[Section]
MESSAGE FROM THE CHAIRMAN

[Content]
People-oriented, permanent protection of employee value. We attach great importance to the health and safety of our employees and have firmly established the safety concept of 'life first'. We continue to enhance our safety management capabilities and standards through whole-process and multi-faceted control measures such as education and training, safety management, review and evaluation. At the same time, the Group implements the concept of 'empathy' in dealing with people, respects human rights and advocates for the human rights principles and standards of international initiatives, including the principles of the United Nations Global Compact, the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, understands the needs and expectations of every employee, pays attention to the rights and welfare of employees, focuses on employee communication and care, and creates a fair, diverse and inclusive working environment. The results of the annual employee satisfaction survey maintain above the industry average.

We are committed to maintaining a sound business environment, strictly abiding by ethical business standards, continuously improving ESG management and promoting synergistic development of economic, environmental and social benefits. During the Reporting Period, the Board continued to strengthen its supervision of ESG matters, placed emphasis on ESG risk identification and management, and set and reviewed ESG objectives. The Sustainable Development Steering Group under the Risk Management Committee continued to provide effective guidance and control on ESG management to facilitate the achievement of ESG objectives. We have adopted a noble code of business conduct to guide all employees and operate our business based on the principles of legal compliance, transparency and integrity, so as to create a fair and competitive business environment and maintain a clean and honest corporate image.

Emphasising Diversified Training

[Content]
The Group regards employee training as the core of its corporate development, and always strives to provide a platform for employees' development and strive to provide multi-level and diversified learning and development opportunities for employees, so as to build a quality talent team for the Group's development. Currently, the Group has formed three major talent training modules, namely 'Talent Echelon Construction', 'Professional Training' and 'Staff Quality Enhancement'.

results.text: The Group adheres to the training management principle of 'classification at different levels, building on strengths and offsetting weaknesses', and sets up targeted training courses according to the responsibilities of different jobs and career development stages, including offline training programmes such as the 'Refined Management-themed Empowerment', the 'Light Chasing Programme' and the 'Maichi Programme', and actively builds an online learning platform to meet the needs of employees to learn anytime and anywhere.
